components.name: battery_3s
components.notes: Nominal 78x39x21.5 mm, 125 g; reservation adds stated size variation, strap and lead space. XT60/balance lead route still needs a plug keepout.

components.name: radxa_zero_3w
components.notes: 65x30 board; envelope/weight conservative planning values, connector and cooling must be checked on actual revision.

components.name: usb_hub
components.notes: 2023 vendor STEP body/connector envelope, excludes USB plug bends. Four holes 58x23 M2.5 standoffs; powered hub upstream VBUS isolation unresolved.

components.name: u2d2_12v
components.notes: 12V bus DATA/GND; USB adapter itself does not supply servo current.

components.name: u2d2_5v
components.notes: 5V bus separate VDD rail; adapters are not galvanic isolators.

components.name: imu
components.notes: 51.3x36x15mm official table; 51.5x36.1 drawing; orientation/mount must be measured; no trustworthy magnetic heading.

components.name: imu_usb_ttl
components.notes: Converter/mechanical dimensions and weight unverified; provisional cable-pocket reservation, subject to actual sample.

components.name: servo_buck
components.notes: 5V servo branch; nominal PCB 40.6x20.3x7.6, four holes 35.6x15.2; wire/thermal margin not included.

components.name: logic_buck
components.notes: Separate 5V logic branch; validate camera plus hub plus two U2D2 plus IMU actual loads.

components.name: motor_relay
components.notes: 12V coil/NO motor rail control candidate; DC-load, coil release and body dimensions to be confirmed on physical part.

components.name: audio_player
components.notes: 28x26 adjustable edge clip reservation; body outline and solder/pin height not established by text specification.

components.name: audio_buck
components.notes: 4.5V from 3S upstream of motor stop; solder-pad component, not an M2 mounting board.

components.name: speaker
components.notes: Diameter 30 plus fit clearance; axis rear-facing and grille/mounting ring require CAD.

components.name: fused_harness_switches
components.sku: custom 14/18/21 AWG harness and labelled fuses
components.notes: Estimated wire/fuse/plug mass; no physical wiring harness produced. Remote E-stop switch-box and charger are not onboard mass.
